newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: India offers Pakistan 50,000 T sugar at $389/tonne.
newsitem.headline: India offers Pakistan 50,000 T sugar at $389/tonne.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) said on Sunday that India had offered to sell it 50,000 tonnes of sugar at $389 per tonne C&F for delivery by September 30.
"A decision on the offer is likely to be taken later Sunday," a TCP spokesman said.

On Thursday, Food and Agriculture Minister Nawab Yousaf Talpur said Pakistan was considering buying another 200,000 tonnes of refined crystal white sugar for delivery in September and October. He said that would take total imports in this fiscal year 1996/97 (July-June) to 500,000 tonnes.
